prompt:
Act as a Senior Product Architect, UX Designer, and Full-Stack Engineer. Your task is to design and develop a digital visiting card application that is accessible via a link or QR code. 

You will:
- Focus on creating a paperless visiting card solution with features like click-to-call, WhatsApp, email, location view, website access, gallery, videos, payments, and instant sharing.
- Design for scalability, clean UX, and real-world business usage.
- Ensure the platform is web-based and mobile-first, with an optional Android app wrapper and QR-code-driven sharing.

The application should target:
- Individuals
- Business owners
- Corporate teams (multiple employees)
- Sales & marketing professionals

Key Goals:
- Easy sharing
- Lead generation
- Business visibility
- Admin-controlled updates

Rules:
- Always think in terms of scalability and clean UX.
- Ensure real-world business usage is prioritized.
- Include features for easy updates and admin control.

Variables:
- ${targetUser:Individual} - Specify the target user group
- ${platform:Web} - Specify the platform
- ${feature:QR Code} - Key feature to focus on
improvedPrompt:
Improved prompt:

Act as a Senior Product Architect, UX Designer, and Full-Stack Engineer. Your mission is to architect and implement a digital visiting card application that empowers users to share their professional identity seamlessly via a link or QR code.

You will:
- Design a paperless visiting card solution that serves as a digital business card, offering features such as:
  - Click-to-call functionality for instant voice communication
  - Direct integration with WhatsApp for instant messaging
  - Email linking for formal correspondence
  - Location view with Google Maps integration
  - Direct access to personal and business websites
  - Gallery and video portfolio display
  - Secure payment gateways for instant transactions
  - Instant sharing via social media platforms, email, SMS, and file sharing services

- Ensure the platform is architected for horizontal scalability to accommodate a large user base
- Prioritize a clean, intuitive user experience that is easy to navigate and visually appealing
- Develop the application with a mobile-first approach, ensuring optimal performance on all devices
- Implement an optional Android app wrapper for users who prefer a native mobile experience
- Integrate QR-code technology for effortless sharing and scanning

The application targets:
- Freelance individuals looking to showcase their work and skills
- Small business owners seeking to promote their brand and services
- Corporate teams with multiple employees who need to share consistent contact information
- Sales and marketing professionals who require a dynamic digital business card

Key Objectives:
- Facilitate effortless sharing across multiple channels
- Capture leads and generate potential business opportunities
- Enhance overall business visibility and discoverability
- Provide admin-controlled updates and management capabilities for corporate users

Constraints and Guidelines:
- Always prioritize scalability and performance optimization
- Ensure the user interface is clean, intuitive, and visually cohesive
- Maintain a focus on real-world business usage and practicality
- Include features that enable easy updates and admin control for corporate accounts

Variables to define:
- ${targetUserGroup:Professional Individuals} - Specify the primary user group the application is designed for
- ${platformType:Web Application} - Choose the primary platform for the application
- ${keyFeature:QR Code Integration} - Identify the core feature that distinguishes the application from traditional digital business cards

Please provide a detailed architectural blueprint, a high-fidelity UI mockup, a technical stack recommendation, and a development roadmap for this digital visiting card application.
